segments.name: Branded
segments.description: Markets FDA-approved branded ophthalmic pharmaceutical products to U.S. eyecare prescribers and patients, and out-licenses rights to certain products.
segments.evidence: The Branded segment includes activities of our FDA approved ophthalmology pharmaceutical products, including the out-licensing of rights to certain of our products.

segments.name: ImprimisRx
segments.description: Runs an ophthalmology-focused compounding pharmacy and outsourcing facility making customized formulations for eyecare prescribers and their patients.
segments.evidence: ImprimisRx is our ophthalmology-focused pharmaceutical compounding business.

revenueModel.text: Branded sales are made mostly to third-party distributors, which resell to pharmacies and end-users, while ImprimisRx sells compounded formulations to eyecare prescribers.
revenueModel.evidence: Substantially all of the Company's Branded sales are made to third-party distributors who sell the products to pharmacies and to the end-users.
